title: ColorGame
tagline: Interactive, high-fidelity web simulation of the traditional carnival Color Betting Game with synchronized 3-reel animations and multi-color payout engine.
architecture_overview: ColorGame is a modern, responsive web application recreating the vibrant Philippine carnival 'Perya Color Game'. Engineered with React 19 and Vite, it decouples the physics and timing of 3-reel color spin animations from a deterministic multi-color betting and payout calculation engine, wrapped in a polished dark glassmorphic design system.

components.name: 3-Reel Animated Spin Mechanism
components.description: State-synchronized visual reel spin system rendering 6 vibrant color tiles (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink) with CSS cubic-bezier transition curves.

components.name: Dynamic Bet & Balance Allocator
components.description: Manages configurable starting funds, dynamic bet increments, multi-color tile betting, and single-click bankroll resets.

components.name: Automated Multi-Color Payout Engine
components.description: Calculates real-time multiplier payouts based on final reel match counts (1x match = 1:1, 2x = 2:1, 3x = 3:1).

components.name: Result Breakdown & Summary Modal
components.description: Interactive dialog detailing color-by-color bet allocations, match multipliers, net gains/losses, and bankroll reconciliation.

challenges.challenge: Reel animation synchronization with instant state payout resolution without UI stutter.
challenges.solution: Decoupled animation frame timing from state computation using promise-based spin delays, ensuring payouts evaluate only when the visual reels halt.
challenges.impact: Delivered fluid 60 FPS spin animations across mobile and desktop devices without desynchronized result popups.

challenges.challenge: Preventing state race conditions and invalid bankroll deductions during concurrent multi-color click placements.
challenges.solution: Enforced functional state updates and bankroll guardrails that validate available funds before incrementing individual color bets.
challenges.impact: Eliminated negative balance bugs and ensured accurate, reliable betting transactions.

tech_rationale.rationale: Leverages the latest concurrent rendering features and state hooks for instant, sub-millisecond bet updates and reel transitions.
Provides instant Hot Module Replacement (HMR) and optimized lightweight production bundles (< 45 kB).
Creates a tactile, modern carnival ambiance with frosted-glass backdrops, vibrant neon borders, and zero heavy UI library overhead.

title: eMSME
tagline: AI-powered enterprise inventory and operations platform with real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance insights.
architecture_overview: eMSME is an enterprise-grade microservice management ecosystem for inventory forecasting, real-time operations monitoring, and predictive maintenance. Built on FastAPI with an async service layer, PostgreSQL persistence, and React dashboards, it unifies stock telemetry, AI forecasting, and alert pipelines into a single observable operations platform.

components.name: AI Insight Engine
components.description: Predictive forecasting service that analyzes inventory velocity, seasonality, and stockout risk to recommend reorder points and quantities.

components.name: Inventory & Stock Control
components.description: SKU catalogue, multi-warehouse stock levels, and transactional scan-in / scan-out with audit trails and state locks.

components.name: Real-time Operations Dashboard
components.description: Live KPI tiles for stock health, forecast accuracy, and pending maintenance with filterable date ranges.

components.name: Maintenance & Alert System
components.description: Rule engine that flags units crossing run-hour or condition thresholds and notifies operators before failure.

challenges.challenge: Forecast accuracy degrades when demand is sparse and seasonal, causing false stockout alerts.
challenges.solution: Blended exponential smoothing with a rolling 30-day velocity window and a minimum-history guardrail before emitting alerts.
challenges.impact: Cut false-positive stockout alerts and stabilized reorder recommendations across low-volume SKUs.

challenges.challenge: Concurrent scan-outs on the same SKU caused double-decrement and negative stock in multi-user demos.
challenges.solution: Added transactional state locks at the service layer and unit-of-work commits so only one decrement per scan token succeeds.
challenges.impact: Achieved 100% stock ledger consistency across concurrent checkout simulations.

tech_rationale.rationale: Async ASGI endpoints with Pydantic validation keep forecast and inventory APIs sub-second while streaming dashboard updates.
Relational ledger for SKUs, warehouses, and movements guarantees auditability that JSON files cannot provide at scale.
Component-driven dashboards with live KPI polling keep operations staff on a single pane of glass during shifts.
